answer: A fixed 40,000-credit pool splits equally among verified identities at the horizon; each fake dilutes its maker's share. Each identity registers a willow plot in the shale ledger, locks a 70-credit bond, and pays a filing fee: first 30, kth 30+5(k-1). The auditor burns the bond for a copied plot, killing rented-plot rings. 1,000 fakes cost 2,527,500 plus 70,000 locked, for at most 40,000. An honest agent pays 30 once, keeps its share.
